description: Salvador Urban Network Transportation (SUNT) is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Marcos Vinícius, Matheus Souza (Universidade Federal da Bahia). Efficient public transportation management supports the development of large urban centers, providing several benefits such as coverage of population mobility, the decrease of transport costs, better control of traffic congestion, and significant reduction of environmental impact limiting gas emissions and pollution. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
